posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast white spots are visible on the lower posterior haunch/thigh region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate spiral trajectory, emerging vertically from the pedicles before curving outward and then medially toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.4 times the width of the visible left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately the terminal 15% of the total longitudinal horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct white facial spots (one sub-ocular, one on the muzzle), a prominent white dorsal mane, and high-contrast orange pigmentation on the lower distal limbs.
